items.item_text: Certified Medical Coder or Certified Medical Biller.

Ability to meet established continuing education requirements by attending required training workshops, and reading materials assigned by AAPC in order to maintain yearly CEUs required for Certified Professional Coder
Minimum of 2 years of billing and coding experience in a Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC) setting.
Experience using Epic EMR/EHR and medical records information systems.
Experience as Medical Record Abstractor

Venice Family Clinic is a leader in providing comprehensive, high-quality health care to people in need regardless of their ability to pay or personal circumstance. The organization has more than 500 staff who serve 45,000 people with compassion, dignity and respect across the Westside of Los Angeles, Inglewood, the South Bay and everywhere in between. We have a network of clinics, Early Head Start centers and mobile clinics plus an expansive street medicine program to reach people experiencing homelessness. Read more about us at venicefamilyclinic.org.

Seeking a Health Info Coder to join our Venice Family Clinic. Under the guidance and direction of the Revenue Cycle Director, the Health Info Coder will code diagnosis and procedures for a multi-specialty group.
Codes, diagnoses, and procedures for a multi-specialty group.
Utilize knowledge of AHA-Coding Clinic and AMA – CPT Assistant guidelines, medical terminology, anatomy and physiology, and pathological basis of disease, documented treatment and procedures.
Assigns ICD-10 CM and CPT codes for patients receiving services at Venice Family Clinic.
Accurately processes outpatient claims to third party payers, following all mandated billing guidelines.
Provides quality control checks on paper claims; processes tracers, denials and related correspondence
Initiates appeals; drafts, composes, and submits appeal letters specific to coding issues consistent with the most updated American Medical Association Current Procedural Terminology.
Identifies and reports any potential compliance risks and reimbursement opportunities to the Revenue Cycle Director.
Performing other duties, which may include computer operation using (Excel, Word, MS Office, 3M Coder), data entry and retrieval.
Assisting other areas as needed and on a daily basis
Note, may on occasion travel to our other locations within Los Angeles County to provide face-to-face training with providers.
Schedule flexibility; able to work as needed on weekends, holidays and other shifts; may be reassigned to areas as needed dependent on overall workload for any area that needs help.
Detailed knowledge and understanding of ICD-9, CPT, and HCPCS coding systems, with ability to accurately assign  ICD-9 and CPT codes.
Knowledge of  CMS and local carrier regulations and requirements for documenting/billing physician services at a teaching hospital
Detailed knowledge of Medical Terminology and its application
Working knowledge of anatomy and physiology, and Medical Record content
Knowledge of HIPAA requirements and ability to maintain confidentiality of sensitive information

Good command of English Grammar and oral and written communication skills, with the ability to speak clearly and distinctly using correct English to answer telephones and communicate with departmental staff or patients
Knowledge of  Microsoft Excel and Word
